name: Leaving Illidan's Guile early ends its stun (#9993)
contract: Illidan's Guile 806109 ("becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 8 sec, but during that time you cannot
attack, move or cast spells") is the immunity aura; its effect 183 applies the restriction aura 807235, which is a stun
plus a pacify-silence and carries SPELL_ATTR0_CANT_CANCEL. Clicking the buff off (CMSG_CANCEL_AURA) removes 806109 but
nothing removed 807235, so the Felsworn left the immunity yet stayed stunned for the rest of the 8 seconds and took
damage. When 806109 ends in any way but its natural expiry the restriction aura now goes with it. A level 32 Felsworn
casts Illidan's Guile and clicks the buff off a second and a half later: both auras must be gone, the stun with them;
a control that is left alone keeps both auras until the full duration.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
SETUP: the restriction aura is on
Click the Illidan's Guile buff off to leave early
DISCRIMINATING: the stun goes with it
The control that stays in keeps its immunity
The control that stays in keeps its restriction
Let the full duration run out
The control's immunity ends on its own
The control's restriction ends on its own
